exclude_claims: Source phase3 structural summary labels 2Z7F as Elafin–NE co-crystal, at 1.90 A; both identity and resolution are wrong.
Source interface residues include HOH waters and then count them as Elafin residues.
Source elafin_docking_real.py contains hard-coded grid, alanine ddG, inhibitor comparisons, designed peptide Ki; Vina unavailable there. These are not executed Elafin docking results.
Source elafin_docking_analysis.py binding energies are literal dictionary values, not computed from poses.
Source NMR flexibility lacks documented structural superposition; do not quote ensemble displacements as dynamics.
AhR receptor 5NJ8 is AHR–ARNT–DNA bHLH/PAS-A complex, not the ligand-binding PAS-B domain; do not use its IPA score as valid AhR ligand binding.
HDAC3 docking requires validated zinc/cofactor handling, protonation, and a redocking control; file presence does not validate the preparation or metal scoring.
FXR GW4064 is a synthetic agonist comparator, not a microbial metabolite; provided scores are weak and grid-sensitive.
